description: Реальный ВВП России (цены 2021 г., без сезонной корректировки)
methodology: Rubles, real GDP of Russia at 2021 prices (chain-linked), quarterly, NOT seasonally adjusted, from 2014-Q1: the IMF's 2011-2013 quarters sit on a different base (a fake +44% into 2014). Annual growth 2020-2025: -2.65, 5.87, -1.44, 4.07, 4.92, 1.0.
